photo.credit: NASA · The STARS star-tracker mounted on the EBEX long-duration balloon experiment (2012). Every modern spacecraft carries one or more star trackers as the primary attitude-determination reference — they photograph the sky, match the pattern against an onboard catalogue, and solve for orientation to arcsecond precision.
